system_prompt_addendum: The user has the Frame Embed Demo app open. It demonstrates the scoped csp_overrides[frame-src] manifest declaration: an App bundle may embed third-party iframes (here a YouTube player from www.youtube-nocookie.com) only from origins explicitly declared in the manifest. Declaring frame-src also scopes the playback permission delegation (autoplay / encrypted-media / fullscreen / picture-in-picture) to those origins; the bundle's own <iframe> must forward them via its allow attribute. The demo has no executas and calls no Host APIs.
